title: Major depression: episode, severity and remission
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's depressive disorder.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for depression.

HPI: Patient is a 57-year-old woman with a history of major depressive disorder, single episode. She reports a stable mood over the last month. She continues to experience low energy and occasional difficulty concentrating. She denies any new concerns since the last visit.

Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 74, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 98.6 F.

Review of Systems:
Neurological: Negative
Psychiatric: Positive (Depressed mood)
Respiratory: Negative
Cardiovascular: Negative
Gastrointestinal: Negative
Musculoskeletal: Negative

Medication List:
Sertraline 100mg daily

Exam:
General: Well-appearing, cooperative, and oriented to person, place, and time.
Psychiatric: Affect is flat. Mood is reported as "okay." Speech is normal in rate and volume. Thought process is linear.

Assessment:
Major depressive disorder, single episode.

Plan:
Continue current dosage of Sertraline. Patient will return in four weeks for follow-up.

Electronically signed, 
S. Patel, NP
October 14, 2026
explanations: Major depressive disorder, single episode, severity not documented (no HCC): F32.9.
